programs.title: It's Our Time
programs.desc: A filmmaker on the verge of being evicted applies for funding to get her script financed and appease her landlord. The funding officer is her only hope, but he soon falls for her best friend. (Tiana Hogben, Peter Thurnwald, Bianca Bradey).

programs.title: Batman
programs.desc: When Bruce Wayne witnesses the murder of both parents in a backstreet alley, he pledges his life to fighting crime. As he matures, Wayne disguises himself as a creature of the night and targets the criminals of Gotham City.

programs.title: Doctor Doolittle
programs.desc: A workaholic doctor estranged from his family rediscovers his ability to communicate with animals, which turns his life upside down and ultimately enables him to mend his ways before he loses everything that's dear to him. (Eddie Murphy).

programs.title: Unstoppable
programs.desc: With an unmanned, half-mile-long freight train barrelling toward a city, a veteran engineer and a young conductor race against the clock to prevent a catastrophe. Starring: Denzel Washington, Chris Pine, Rosario Dawson.

programs.title: The Beekeeper
programs.desc: One man's brutal campaign for vengeance takes on national stakes after it's revealed he's a former operative of a powerful and clandestine organization known as Beekeepers. Starring: Jason Statham, Josh Hutcherson, Jeremy Irons.

programs.title: Seinfeld
programs.desc: Seinfeld stars Jerry Seinfeld as a stand-up comedian whose life in New York City is made even more chaotic by his quirky group of friends who join him in wrestling with life's most perplexing, yet often trivial questions.

programs.title: World Endurance Championship
programs.desc: The most famous event in endurance racing returns in 2026. The legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans is set to take place at Circuit de la Sarthe in France. Join us for the first 2 hours of this iconic race.

programs.title: The Emu War
programs.desc: Based on the infamous Great Emu War of 1932, a rag tag platoon of soldiers are driven into a brutal and bloody battle against Australia's deadliest flightless beasts. (Damian Callinan, Lisa Fineberg).

programs.title: Big Rigs Of Oz
programs.desc: Big machines meet road safety as we explore Case IH's powerful agricultural gear in action and how Treadcare supports Australia's heavy vehicles with expert tyre solutions and maintenance that keep rigs rolling strong.

programs.title: Barney's World
programs.desc: During a magical go-kart race Mel discovers that there's more to racing than just winning. / When Vivie accidentally breaks Mel's toy and is too afraid to admit it, Barney helps Vive find the courage to tell the truth.

programs.title: I Love VIP Pets
programs.sub_title: The Lucky Curler/S.O.S Trees/The Eclipse Wish
programs.desc: Oh no! They want to destroy all the palm trees of Glam City to make a shopping mall. To make sure it does not happen, Lady Gigi will try to get the maximum likes on Instadog to present it to the town hall.
